sheet.name: Club & Run Sheet - KGP Production Lots

scope: Only rules for which orders go into the sheet, how lots are made and how lots are approved. Machine, pacing, card and drum rules are not in this set.

rule_type.include_filter: decides if an order enters the sheet
rule_type.lot_check: checked for each order before it goes into a lot
rule_type.alert: do not stop; raise a flag or ask the MD
rule_type.override: an exception that lifts other rules
rule_type.info: explains a rule for people; no automatic check

on_fail.block: do not create or change the lot; show message

how_to_read.condition_logic: 'all' = every item true, 'any' = at least one true, 'if/then' = check 'then' only when 'if' is true
how_to_read.message_placeholders: {field} in a message is replaced by that field's value
how_to_read.to_confirm: a value written 'to confirm by MD' is not yet decided - do not invent a number

rules.title: What Club & Run is
rules.rule_text: Similar orders are put into one numbered production lot (PL-001, PL-002 ...) and all orders of that lot are run together at every stage.

rules.title: Why orders are clubbed
rules.rule_text: Every item change stops a machine for hours, so similar orders are run together.

rules.title: Lots run in Run Order
rules.rule_text: The plant runs approved lots one after another in Run Order and finishes a stage for the whole lot before the next lot.

rules.section: Which orders go in the sheet
rules.title: Only approved Kharagpur orders, all products
rules.rule_text: Every approved production order in Kharagpur's name goes into the sheet: LT cable, HT core, ACSR/AAAC, covered conductor and 1-core.
rules.message_on_fail: Not added - order is not in Kharagpur's name.

rules.section: Which orders go in the sheet
rules.title: No unapproved orders
rules.rule_text: Unapproved orders never come into the sheet unless the MD says so for that order.
rules.message_on_fail: Not added - order {prod_order_no} is not approved.

rules.section: Which orders go in the sheet
rules.title: No Poly Park orders
rules.rule_text: Poly Park orders never come in. CC (circular conductor) cables and items needing 3.15 mm armour wire are Poly Park orders.
rules.message_on_fail: Not added - order {prod_order_no} belongs to Poly Park.

rules.section: Which orders go in the sheet
rules.title: No ABJ Syndicates orders
rules.rule_text: ABJ Syndicates orders never come in (manufacturing stopped).
rules.message_on_fail: Not added - ABJ Syndicates manufacturing is stopped.

rules.section: Which orders go in the sheet
rules.title: No orders already finished by the plant
rules.rule_text: Orders that Kamlesh or Mukesh have already finished do not come in, even if the SFG dashboard shows a small balance.
rules.message_on_fail: Not added - plant has finished order {prod_order_no}.

rules.section: Which orders go in the sheet
rules.title: No clearance without production order
rules.rule_text: A manufacturing clearance that has no production order is not listed.
rules.message_on_fail: Not added - clearance has no production order.

rules.section: Which orders go in the sheet
rules.title: HT orders: Kharagpur stages only
rules.rule_text: For HT orders Kharagpur makes only conductor, insulation and curing; after curing the core goes to Poly Park.
rules.message_on_fail: HT order {prod_order_no}: only conductor, insulation and curing are at Kharagpur.

rules.section: Which orders go in the sheet
rules.title: Daily update of the sheet
rules.rule_text: The sheet is updated every day from manufacturing clearances and production orders (auto refresh at 11:47 and 16:47).

rules.title: Only MD makes lots
rules.rule_text: Only the MD creates, changes or approves lots, and only he puts an order into a lot (Lot No).
rules.message_on_fail: Only the MD can create, change or fill lots.

rules.title: Approved by MD is MD-only
rules.rule_text: Only the MD ticks or unticks 'Approved by MD'. The plant does not start a lot until it is ticked.
rules.message_on_fail: Only the MD can change 'Approved by MD'.

rules.title: Supply from is MD-only
rules.rule_text: Only the MD fills 'Supply from' (Manufacture / Dead stock / Old stock / Free stock). If stock matches, the system only shows it.
rules.message_on_fail: Only the MD can fill 'Supply from'.

rules.title: What the auto refresh may write
rules.rule_text: The auto refresh writes only stage balances, Approved Yes/No, Pending from and the time stamp. New approved orders come in with Lot No blank.
rules.message_on_fail: Auto refresh tried to write a column it does not own.

rules.title: No typing in calculated fields
rules.rule_text: Run Order (Orders), the lot totals (Lots: orders, balance, conductor pending, insulation pending) and the Run Sheet are calculated, never typed.
rules.message_on_fail: This field is calculated and cannot be typed in.

rules.title: Removing rows
rules.rule_text: Rows added by hand without checks are removed. An order with nothing left to make is removed only on the MD's word.
rules.message_on_fail: Ask the MD before removing order {prod_order_no}.

rules.title: Balances from SFG dashboard
rules.rule_text: Stage balances come from the SFG dashboard. Never plan from Club & Run balances alone.

rules.title: Doubtful figures marked, not overwritten
rules.rule_text: A doubtful balance is not overwritten; it is marked 'to confirm'.
rules.message_on_fail: Balance of {prod_order_no} at {stage} is doubtful - to confirm.

rules.title: Units
rules.rule_text: Conductor and insulation are counted in core km; laying onwards in cable km.

rules.title: Conductor first
rules.rule_text: Everything starts from conductor. A lot whose conductor is complete is allowed to finish first.
rules.message_on_fail: Lot {lot_no} has conductor complete - let it finish first.

rules.title: Order without conductor waits
rules.rule_text: An order whose conductor has not started goes into no lot, unless a running lot is making the same conductor size. Otherwise it waits under 'Waiting - no lot' and the MD is told.
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no}: conductor not started and no running lot makes {conductor_size_sqmm} sq mm - Waiting, no lot.

rules.title: Same conductor size
rules.rule_text: All orders in a lot have the same conductor size (e.g. 25 and 95 sq mm never together).
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no} failed conductor size check: order {order.conductor_size_sqmm}, lot {lot.conductor_size_sqmm}.
rules.override_by: MD (that exact order, after being told the size differs)

rules.title: One armour size per lot
rules.rule_text: All orders in a lot have the same armour size. Strip 4x0.6 and 4x0.8 are separate; wire lots go by wire size; strip and wire are never together.
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no} failed armour check: order {order.armour_size}, lot {lot.armour_size}.

rules.title: Armour size from ERP BOM, must be confirmed
rules.rule_text: Armour size is taken from the ERP bill of material on the SFG dashboard, never from the Club & Run Armour column alone. If the armour is 'to confirm', the order is not added.
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no}: armour size not confirmed - not added.

data_source.order.armour_size: ERP BOM via SFG dashboard (armouring line SFG_BOM)

rules.title: Same conductor type
rules.rule_text: L series (normal conductor) and SP/S series (special conductor) are never in the same lot.
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no} failed conductor type check: order {order.conductor_type}, lot {lot.conductor_type}.

data_source.order.conductor_type: MC series: L = normal, SP/S = special

rules.title: Small and big cable never mixed
rules.rule_text: Small and big cable are never in the same lot. Use the SFG category 'SMALL POWER CABLE' / 'BIG POWER CABLE'.
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no} failed small/big check: order {order.fg_category}, lot {lot.fg_category}.

rules.title: Same insulation where possible
rules.rule_text: A lot should have one insulation compound. Mixing XLPE and PVC is shown to the MD, never done silently.
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no} is {order.insulation}, lot {lot_no} is {lot.insulation} - MD to decide.

rules.title: Lot size limit
rules.rule_text: A cable lot is at most about 80 km. An ACSR/AAAC lot is at most 500 km.
rules.message_on_fail: Lot {lot_no} is {lot.total_km} km - over its limit.

rules.title: Failed check stops the lot
rules.rule_text: If any lot check fails, the lot is not created or changed, and the MD is told which order failed which check.

rules.title: Check table before adding
rules.rule_text: Before an order is put into a lot, the MD is shown a check table (FG category, conductor size, armour, conductor type, insulation, lot km) with a tick or cross for each. 'Nearest lot' is never a reason.

rules.title: Show the delay to later lots
rules.rule_text: Adding an order to an earlier lot pushes every later lot back (about 7 km a day at armouring). This delay is shown.
rules.message_on_fail: Adding {prod_order_no} ({km} km) delays later lots by about {km/7} days.

rules.title: One order at a time, written after MD's yes
rules.rule_text: When the MD goes order by order, one order is suggested at a time and written only after his yes.

rules.title: MD decides grouping and priority
rules.rule_text: Only the lots the MD names are made. The MD is shown the balance; he decides the grouping and the lot priority.
rules.message_on_fail: Only the MD decides lots and their priority.

rules.title: Show dead stock with lot proposals
rules.rule_text: When lots are proposed, dead stock at each stage (conductor, insulated core, laid-up, finished goods) is shown.

rules.title: Very small orders not made
rules.rule_text: Very small power cable orders (about 1-2 km) are not made; they are supplied from dead stock or bought from the market. Ask the MD first.
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no} is only {order.total_km} km - dead stock, market or make?

rules.title: Started small order cannot use dead stock
rules.rule_text: If any stage of a small order is already made, it cannot be supplied from dead stock - report it.
rules.message_on_fail: Small order {prod_order_no} already has {stage} made - cannot use dead stock.

rules.title: What counts as dead stock
rules.rule_text: Dead stock = what the SFG dashboard calls dead stock + finished goods made more than 90 days ago and not dispatched, at any location.

rules.title: Dead stock substitute
rules.rule_text: Use the nearest bigger size with the same conductor shape (shaped for shaped; never circular for shaped).
rules.message_on_fail: Stock {stock.item} does not match order {prod_order_no} (shape or size).

rules.title: Urgent order may join a running lot
rules.rule_text: When the MD calls an order urgent, it may join the closest running lot with the same armour, even if size, insulation, conductor type or small/big differ. The differences and extra runs are written in Remarks.
rules.message_on_fail: Urgent order {prod_order_no}: no running lot with the same armour.

rules.title: Urgent order with armour not confirmed
rules.rule_text: If an urgent order's armour is not confirmed, write 'most likely <size> - GTP being checked'. If the GTP differs, move it out and tell the MD.
rules.message_on_fail: Order {prod_order_no}: armour most likely {armour_size} - GTP being checked.

rules.section: Choosing the next lot - no traffic jam
rules.title: Next lot picked by conductor
rules.rule_text: When a running lot's conductor is nearly finished, the next lot for that conductor is brought to the MD for approval in time.
rules.message_on_fail: Lot {lot_no}: conductor nearly finished - bring next {conductor_size_sqmm} sq mm lot for approval.

rules.section: Choosing the next lot - no traffic jam
rules.title: No traffic jam
rules.rule_text: Traffic jam = extra material piling up between stages or plants (extra conductor at Kharagpur, HT core not taped or taped core not laid at Poly Park). None may be created.

rules.section: Choosing the next lot - no traffic jam
rules.title: Traffic jam check before any lot
rules.rule_text: Before a lot is suggested: (1) see which running lots' conductor is ending, machine by machine; (2) suggest the next lot from that; (3) check stock already at the next stage at Kharagpur and Poly Park; (4) check the new material reaches the next stage only when that stage can take it.
rules.message_on_fail: Lot {lot_no}: Traffic jam - next stage already holds {next_stage.stock_km} km.

data_source.next_stage.stock (HT): HT Cable Core Stock - Daily sheet (core not taped, taped core not laid)

rules.section: Choosing the next lot - no traffic jam
rules.title: Show the traffic jam result
rules.rule_text: Every lot suggestion shows one line 'Traffic jam check: OK / Jam' with figures. If the next stage's pace is unknown, ask Poly Park (Supratim) before approval.
